name: Valki
description: The god of lies, tricked and chained by Tibalt, who was imprisoned in King Narfi's palace in Karfell while Tibalt used his guise.

timeline.summary: Tibalt tricks Valki, the God of Lies, to use him as a disguise.
timeline.quote: It happened that this God of Lies, this Prince of Tricksters, was foolish enough to get lied to and tricked himself.

timeline.summary: Tibalt chains Valki and imprisons him in King Narfi's glacial palace in Karfell, striking a deal with Narfi.
timeline.quote: So long as Valki stayed deep in the dungeon of this King Narfi's glacial palace

relations.quote: Tibalt wrapped Valki in magical chains and brought him to the coldest, most remote realm he could find: Karfell.

pages_say.description: The god of lies, tricked and chained by Tibalt, who was imprisoned in King Narfi's palace in Karfell while Tibalt used his guise.
